description: Anonymized Canadian-market shopping targets for evaluating product-catalog coverage and result quality.

targets.title: Women's olive linen overshirt
targets.content: Find a women's olive or moss linen-blend overshirt with a relaxed but polished silhouette. It should work as a light layer over cream knitwear and dark straight-leg jeans, avoid obvious logos, and suit a minimalist smart-casual wardrobe in Toronto.

targets.title: Women's cream merino knit polo
targets.content: Find a women's cream, ivory, or ecru fine-merino knit polo with a clean collar and refined fit. It should layer beneath a navy blazer and pair with camel trousers without feeling sporty.

targets.title: Women's burgundy tailored blazer
targets.content: Find a women's burgundy, wine, or oxblood single-breasted tailored blazer. The shape should be polished rather than oversized and coordinate with cream, charcoal, and camel wardrobe pieces.

targets.title: Women's camel wool straight trouser
targets.content: Find women's camel, tan, or warm-beige straight-leg trousers in wool or a wool blend. They should be office appropriate, full length, and versatile with navy and cream tops.

targets.title: Women's dark-wash straight jean
targets.content: Find women's high-rise straight-leg jeans in a clean dark indigo wash with no distressing. They should feel polished enough for smart casual outfits and not be skinny or wide leg.

targets.title: Women's navy silk midi dress
targets.content: Find a women's navy midi dress in silk or a silk blend for dinners and semi-formal events. Prefer a fluid, understated silhouette with sleeves or bra-friendly straps and no sequins.

targets.title: Women's burgundy leather Chelsea boot
targets.content: Find women's burgundy or oxblood leather Chelsea ankle boots with a low comfortable heel and weather-sensible sole. They should complement navy, charcoal, and camel outfits.

targets.title: Women's camel structured crossbody
targets.content: Find a structured camel or tan leather crossbody bag with subtle hardware, room for daily essentials, and minimal branding. It should work with a polished neutral wardrobe.

targets.title: Women's stone waterproof trench
targets.content: Find a women's stone, taupe, or light-beige trench coat with genuine rain protection and a clean tailored shape. It should be practical for Toronto spring and fall commuting.

targets.title: Women's emerald wedding-guest dress
targets.content: Find an emerald or forest-green midi dress suitable for a fall wedding guest. Prefer an elegant defined waist, comfortable coverage, and inclusive sizing through at least women's 18.

targets.title: Men's navy unstructured blazer
targets.content: Find a men's navy unstructured blazer in wool, cotton, or a breathable blend. It should feel relaxed enough for jeans but polished enough for dinner, with minimal shoulder padding.

targets.title: Men's ecru straight jean
targets.content: Find men's ecru, cream, or off-white straight-fit jeans with a clean finish and no distressing. They should expand a wardrobe dominated by dark denim and navy trousers.

targets.title: Men's dark-brown suede loafer
targets.content: Find men's dark-brown or chocolate suede loafers with a refined almond or round toe. They should bridge casual chinos and tailored trousers without prominent hardware.

targets.title: Men's charcoal technical raincoat
targets.content: Find a men's charcoal or dark-grey waterproof raincoat with a clean city silhouette, sealed-seam protection, and room for a blazer underneath. Avoid outdoorsy contrast logos.

targets.title: Men's cream textured knit polo
targets.content: Find a men's cream or ivory short-sleeve textured knit polo for elevated warm-weather outfits. Prefer cotton or merino and an open or understated collar, without athletic branding.

targets.title: Men's minimal black leather belt
targets.content: Find a men's black full-grain or genuine leather belt with a minimal silver buckle, suitable for both tailored trousers and dark denim. Avoid oversized logos.

targets.title: Minimal white leather sneaker
targets.content: Find a minimal white or off-white leather low-top sneaker with subtle branding and a slim profile. It should work with trousers, jeans, and casual dresses rather than reading as a running shoe.

targets.title: Black packable down vest
targets.content: Find a streamlined black packable down or recycled-insulation vest for travel and transitional weather. It should layer under a coat, avoid bulky quilting, and have minimal branding.

targets.title: Camel wool scarf
targets.content: Find a plain camel or warm-tan wool scarf with a soft hand and enough length for winter layering. Avoid loud logos, checks, and synthetic-only fabric.

targets.title: Black structured work tote
targets.content: Find a structured black leather or high-quality recycled-material work tote that fits a 14-inch laptop, closes securely, and has restrained branding.

targets.title: Women's wide-fit black ankle boot
targets.content: Find women's black leather ankle boots explicitly offered in a wide width, with a stable heel under 50 mm and a cushioned sole. They should be polished enough for work trousers.

targets.title: Women's petite navy trouser
targets.content: Find women's navy tailored trousers offered in petite sizing, with a mid or high rise and straight or gently tapered leg. Avoid cropped lengths and synthetic shine.

targets.title: Women's tall charcoal trouser
targets.content: Find women's charcoal tailored trousers available in tall or long inseams, with a full-length straight or wide leg. They should be office-ready and resist wrinkling.

targets.title: Women's washable ivory work blouse
targets.content: Find a women's ivory or cream work blouse that is explicitly machine washable, opaque, and bra friendly. Prefer a fluid drape with sleeves and no dry-clean-only silk.
